notes.title: In Other Waters Turns Five Years Old!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33278734/1c17cd8fb16fc705f515e7b21a83d681fcfc09aa.png[/img]

It's unbelievable! Jump Over the Age's debut title, In Other Waters, has turned five years old already! We'd like to take the opportunity to thank everyone who's explored the alien oceans of Gliese 667Cc with Ellery.

To celebrate, Jump Over the Age is partnering with Lost In Cult for a limited edition of some incredible In Other Waters treasures.
[h2]In a hurry? Pre-orders are open [url=https://www.lostincult.co.uk/inotherwaters][b]here![/b][/url][/h2]
Now, let's take a look!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33278734/324ffaa729b36aa0fa0a8677b27bef4b369fad79.png[/img]
First off is a physical reprint of A Study of Gliese 667Cc - the companion book which acts as both an epilogue to the story of In Other Waters and a partial catalog of some of the life players will discover in their study of the planet. Filled with sketches and paintings of the creatures and planet of Gliese 667Cc by the game’s developer Gareth Damian Martin, it is a window into a beautiful alien world. Previously only available in a limited run for the game’s 2018 Kickstarter, this is a unique opportunity to get a physical copy of this highly sought after book.

[i]Limited Edition of 500 units[/i]
[list]
[*] Hardcover book
[*] New cover art
[*] 100 pages
[*] 280 x 240 mm
[*] Section sewn binding
[*] 150 gsm premium paper stock
[/list]

In addition, Lost in Cult is re-releasing the game’s wondrous ambient soundtrack by Amos Roddy on new, limited edition transparent yellow vinyl. Also, for the first time we’re releasing a limited edition cassette on transparent yellow tape. Both vinyl and cassette releases come with all new cover art by Eisner-nominated comic artist Linnea Sterte.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33278734/bd9b72019a3260dc4ad89cc432179f72524a40a8.png[/img][i]Vinyl - Limited Edition of 300 units[/i]
[list]
[*] Single LP 12” Vinyl Record
[*] New cover art by Linnea Sterte
[*] Pressed on transparent yellow vinyl
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33278734/8a46dda09dc4d08714b5838de7ceb139e86f4386.png[/img][i]Cassette - Limited Edition of 200 units[/i]
[list]
[*] C45 Cassette Tape
[*] Cover art by Linnea Sterte
[*] Transparent yellow cassette tape with black print
[/list][h2]Pre-orders are open NOW and can be found [url=https://www.lostincult.co.uk/inotherwaters]here![/url][/h2]

Thanks again to all our players for being a part of this incredible journey. Here's to the next five years!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/890720/In_Other_Waters/

notes.title: Citizen Sleeper Design Works Book, TTRPG and more!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379870/1b4c1f56c128bc05746757519446fc5908c5c424.png[/img]

The next instalment in Lost in Cult’s premium series of design-focussed art books is here! Join us as we venture into the lawless reaches of a far-flung space station on the edge of interplanetary capitalism. This anniversary celebration of Citizen Sleeper comes in multifarious forms, with an official, high-end Design Works art book, an innovative new tabletop role-playing adventure, a beautiful vinyl record package, and many more extras besides.

The core Design Works book will highlight the incredible artistry of both the main game and its three DLC episodes (Flux, Refuge, and Purge). We’ll be zooming in on the details and minutiae of its art, discussing the game’s many influences and inspirations, and digging deep into ephemeral design processes with extended, developer-led captions, as well as key interviews and discussions with creator Gareth Damian Martin.

Alongside this, Lost in Cult is publishing something wholly inventive: a fully-fledged solo tabletop RPG, Cycles of the Eye, created by Gareth Damian Martin in collaboration with designer Alfred Valley, that pulls you into the universe of Citizen Sleeper. Buy the art book and TTRPG separately, or together as part of our stunning Deluxe or all-in-one Anniversary editions — available only during this limited funding campaign. Help us celebrate one year of Citizen Sleeper!

Here's what's in each edition:

[b]Citizen Sleeper - Design Works  - GBP £39.99[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379870/d43fb7f1a3fea9e0185f693fccd6ba3346e59ec6.png[/img]
This 250+ page premium hardcover book comes with a Spot Gloss finish, highlighting the eponymous “Sleeper” player-protagonist. With a section sewn binding and an OBI strip printed in Citizen Sleeper’s iconic Magenta, even the Standard Edition is a collector’s item that’ll look as good on your coffee table as it will on your bookshelf.

It includes:
[list]
[*] Spot Gloss hardcover book
[*] 210 x 297 mm (A4)
[*] 250 pages approx.
[*] Section sewn binding
[*] “Citizen Magenta” OBI strip
[/list][b]Citizen Sleeper – Cycles of the Eye - GBP £29.99[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379870/32f86d4711453e12a88937c72ec28e13fbe7eec2.png[/img]
The Citizen Sleeper tabletop game, Cycles of the Eye, uses dice and tarot cards (both Minor and Major Arcana) to create a solo journey through the game's location of Erlin’s Eye. Over the course of several cycles, you will complete challenges, reveal new locations and interact with iconic characters, building a story unique to your session from the included tarot deck. Who will your allies and adversaries be? Will your Sleeper build a new life on the Eye or escape it entirely?

The TTRPG is designed for solo-play — intimate and innovative. This new step in the Citizen Sleeper universe is a collaboration between Gareth Damian Martin, and Alfred Valley, the creator of ingenious solo RPGs like Lay On Hands and Thousand Empty Light.

Cycles of the Eye includes:
[list]
[*] TTRPG “Cycles of the Eye” zine book
[*] 78 Card Tarot Deck
[/list][b]Design Works / Cycles of the Eye Deluxe - GBP £119.99[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379870/59c9a61b292b174a71013424463d5241ec3bdf4c.png[/img]
The Deluxe Edition of Citizen Sleeper: Design Works includes the Standard edition art book, as well as a unique, special edition of the tabletop RPG, Cycles of the Eye, wrapped in a premium gloss cover. Exclusive to this and the Anniversary edition are our dice sets, custom designed for Cycles of the Eye but also usable as D6s for any tabletop session. This edition also comes with Holographic Foil details on its 78 Card Tarot Deck, two bookmarks, and a set of in-world iron-on patches based on those worn by the character Moritz in the game. Most importantly, all of this comes housed in a beautiful, custom box — coloured what we like to call “Citizen Magenta” with a metallic finish — boasting a magnetic clasp.

The Deluxe Edition includes everything from Citizen Sleeper - Design Works, plus:
[list]
[*] Deluxe box with metallic finish and magnetic clasp
[*] Deluxe TTRPG “Cycles of the Eye” zine with gloss wrap cover
[*] Deluxe Holographic Foil 78 Card Tarot Deck
[*] 5 Energy Dice (Yellow)
[*] 5 Cycle Dice (Citizen Magenta)
[*] Bookmark
[*] Patches
[/list][b]Vinyl Soundtrack - GBP £39.99[/b] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379870/168dbcbfc87ad4f4d03a8a1ef823e8ee62617ff4.png[/img]In addition to the release of our Design Works book, Lost in Cult is working alongside music label Stumpy Frog Records to bring you a signature 12-inch vinyl featuring an acetate sleeve with printed details. Designed to replicate a classic Japanese animation cell layout, as a tribute to the game’s anime influences, this gatefold LP also features interior “lo-fi” art of the Sleeper and the stray in their ramshackle apartment. Original soundtrack by Amos Roddy.

[b]Citizen Sleeper - Anniversary Bundle - GBP £249.99[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379870/a1ddaef77907bd872bbb5385f2246b1ac113f588.png[/img]
The ultimate celebration of Citizen Sleeper’s one year anniversary. This edition not only includes everything in the Deluxe, but also adds a vinyl record of the game’s iconic soundtrack presented in a beautiful gatefold cover, an exclusive anniversary slipmat for your record player, and a print of the specially-commissioned anniversary celebration art signed by both Guillaume Singelin and Gareth Damian Martin.

The Anniversary Edition includes everything from Design Works / Cycles of the Eye Deluxe, plus:
[list]
[*] A2 Print signed by Guillaume Singelin and Gareth Damian Martin/Jump Over the Age
[*] 12-inch Vinyl Record with acetate sleeve with painted details
[*] Exclusive Anniversary Slipmat

[/list][h3]Pre-order today from Lost in Cult and immerse yourself in the world of Citizen Sleeper: [url=https://www.lostincult.co.uk/citizensleeper]https://www.lostincult.co.uk/citizensleeper[/url][/h3]
Don’t forget to sign-up to [url=https://jumpovertheage.substack.com/]our Substack[/url]. It’ll ensure you don’t miss the upcoming reveal, and you’ll automatically go into the draw to win an awesome prize pack, to be revealed tomorrow!

And remember to stay up to date with all the latest Citizen Sleeper news here:

notes.title: New CITIZEN SLEEPER Episodes Announced!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=98pWVYjx2z0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]THREE NEW DLC EPISODES[/b][/h3]
Jump Over The Age and Fellow Traveller are thrilled to reveal that Citizen Sleeper will be receiving [b]new story content via three FREE episodic updates[/b], the first of which “[b]FLUX[/b]”, arrives in [b]July (date TBC)[/b]. [b]Episodes 2 and 3[/b] are currently planned for release in [b]October and early 2023[/b] respectively, however dates are still to be confirmed.

[h3][b]THE ROADMAP[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379870/8a41c042c9c9128b1912e7a6233166dd00230827.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]EPISODE 1: FLUX[/b][/h3]
In the first episode, [b]FLUX[/b], pressures in the Helion system have brought the first ships of a refugee flotilla to the Eye. You will meet and help those that get on-station before the quarantine locks them out.

These episodes will tell a continuing story across all three updates, expanding on the wider narrative of the Helion System, the star system in which the Eye orbits. Each episode will also introduce new characters, the first of which we are revealing today: [b]Eshe[/b].

[h3][b]INTRODUCING ESHE[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379870/7dc158f64a9ebbaef2d003ecff1c4c5dc3979cbd.png[/img]

[b]Eshe[/b] is a stubborn and driven spacer, whose fate becomes tangled up in that of the refugee flotilla which had begun to arrive at the Eye. Her story will ask the player to choose how to deal with a growing crisis that could threaten the entire station.

notes.title: Citizen Sleeper Reviews
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379870/4d3e1bd4e3d3a0ed99154b79c0a3839284a0b687.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Citizen Sleeper Review Round-Up[/b][/h3]

Only one day until Citizen Sleeper releases. The coverage embargo has lifted, and reviews are starting to come in. Here's what people are saying:

[url=https://www.vice.com/en/article/jgmzzy/citizen-sleeper-review][b]Waypoint[/b][/url]: [i]Citizen Sleeper stands out as one of the best games of the year, with great writing that avoids easy outs.[/i] - Renata Price

[url=https://www.theguardian.com/games/2022/may/04/citizen-sleeper-review-an-evocative-cyberpunk-survival-sim][b]The Guardian[/b][/url] - 4/5: [i]There are far more stories to tell in this fascinating universe, and this is some of the finest video-game sci-fi writing out there.[/i] - Lewis Packwood

[url=https://www.inverse.com/gaming/citizen-sleeper-review-pc-xbox-game-pass][b]Inverse[/b][/url] - 8/10: [i]The story of Citizen Sleeper is one of the most thoughtful and emotionally satisfying I’ve ever played. Your story will be different, and I wholeheartedly recommend that you find out what it is.[/i] - Bryan Lawler

[url=https://www.destructoid.com/reviews/citizen-sleeper-review-pc-steam-game-pass/][b]Destructoid[/b][/url] - 9/10: [i]...a sci-fi story that sticks. Some stories were good, and others hit me like a bag of bricks.[/i] - Eric Van Allen

[url=https://metro.co.uk/2022/05/03/citizen-sleeper-review-space-oddity-16579853/][b]Metro[/b][/url]: [i]An absorbing mix of tabletop inspirations and sci-fi storytelling, that makes for one of the most unique and well-written games of the year.[/i] - Adam Starkey

[url=https://press-start.com.au/reviews/xbox-series-x-reviews/2022/05/04/citizen-sleeper-review-slick-and-succinct-sci-fi/][b]Press Start[/b][/url] - 9/10: [i]It's not often that a game grabs me in quite the way Citizen Sleeper has. Top-notch writing, impeccable narrative design and inviting tabletop mechanics accompanied by gorgeous art and music serve only to elevate it even more. Play this bloody game.[/i] - Kieron Verbrugge

[url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/citizen-sleeper-review][b]Rock, Paper, Shotgun[/b][/url]: [i]A swish sci-fi RPG full of decent folk and just the right amount of scum.[/i] - Brendan Caldwell

[url=https://comicbook.com/gaming/news/citizen-sleeper-review-nintendo-switch/][b]ComicBook.com[/b][/url]: [i]Citizen Sleeper has captured my imagination in a way that few video games do.[/i] - Rollin Bishop

[url=https://screenrant.com/citizen-sleeper-game-review/][b]Screen Rant[/b][/url]: [i]Citizen Sleeper is fantastic. It's a deep and well-crafted narrative experience with a fascinating setting, and is filled with plenty of challenging questions for players to ponder over. This is a game that gets cyberpunk right.[/i] - Rob Gordon

[url=https://www.polygon.com/reviews/23053260/citizen-sleeper-review-cyberpunk-sci-fi-rpg-tabletop][b]Polygon[/b][/url]: [i]Capitalism is an endless bitch, but I quickly learn that even in the face of truly bleak choices, the game always allows the Sleeper to retain a soft, haunting sense of humanity through dialogue and actions.[/i] - Alexis Ong
